mapper.select: SELECT nvl(100-sum(nvl(PRIN_AMT,0)),100) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= MDATE GROUP BY FINPROD_ID

SELECT T.SEQNO, T.CREDIT_TYPE, T.CREDIT_MST_ID, T.CUSTOMER_ID, T.CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) END HAP_CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) END CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.CREDIT_FLAG, T.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, T.SINGER_SEC_RATIO, T.PFLSH, T.REMARK, T.CREDIT_CONDITION, T.CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.CCY, T.IS_INTERBANK, T.IS_LOOP_AMT, T.HOLD_MATURITY, T.CREDIT_OBJ, T.APPR_VDATE, T.APPR_MDATE, T.CREDIT_VDATE, T.CREDIT_MDATE, T.CREATE_USER, T.CREATE_DEPT, T.CREATE_TIME, T.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME FROM CREDIT_LINES T LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(M.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, SUM(M.NEW_AMOUNT) NEW_AMOUNT FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER M WHERE M.CDATE <= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND M.STATUS = '01' GROUP BY M.CUSTOMER_ID ) TM ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = TM.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T.CUSTOMER_ID = #{deductObj,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.VDATE <= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T.MDATE >= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CREDIT_CONF_INFO CI WHERE CI.CREDIT_MST_ID = T.CREDIT_MST_ID) AND T.CREDIT_MST_ID = '0001' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CREDIT_LINES CL WHERE CL.CREDIT_MST_ID = T.CREDIT_MST_ID AND CL.CUSTOMER_ID = T.CUSTOMER_ID AND CL.VDATE <= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND CL.MDATE >= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} and CL.VDATE > T.VDATE )

SELECT T.SEQNO, T.CREDIT_TYPE, T.CREDIT_MST_ID, T.CUSTOMER_ID, T.CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) END HAP_CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) END CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.CREDIT_FLAG, T.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, T.SINGER_SEC_RATIO, T.PFLSH, T.REMARK, T.CREDIT_CONDITION, T.CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.CCY, T.IS_INTERBANK, T.IS_LOOP_AMT, T.HOLD_MATURITY, T.CREDIT_OBJ, T.APPR_VDATE, T.APPR_MDATE, T.CREDIT_VDATE, T.CREDIT_MDATE, T.CREATE_USER, T.CREATE_DEPT, T.CREATE_TIME, T.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME FROM CREDIT_LINES T LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M.FINPROD_ID, SUM(M.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, SUM(M.NEW_AMOUNT) NEW_AMOUNT FROM CREDIT_USING_AST M WHERE M.CDATE <= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND M.STATUS = '01' GROUP BY M.FINPROD_ID ) TM ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = TM.FINPROD_ID WHERE T.CUSTOMER_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.VDATE <= #{tradeDate} AND T.MDATE >= #{tradeDate} AND T.CREDIT_MST_ID=#{creditmstidZC,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CREDIT_LINES CL WHERE CL.CREDIT_MST_ID = T.CREDIT_MST_ID AND CL.CUSTOMER_ID = T.CUSTOMER_ID AND CL.VDATE <= #{tradeDate} AND CL.MDATE >= #{tradeDate} and CL.VDATE > T.VDATE )

SELECT T.SEQNO, T.CREDIT_TYPE, T.CREDIT_MST_ID, T.CUSTOMER_ID, T.CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.AMOUNT,0) END HAP_CREDIT_AMT, CASE WHEN NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN T.CREDIT_AMT < NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) THEN T.CREDIT_AMT ELSE NVL(TM.NEW_AMOUNT,0) END CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.CREDIT_FLAG, T.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, T.SINGER_SEC_RATIO, T.PFLSH, T.REMARK, T.CREDIT_CONDITION, T.CREDIT_AMT_ADD, T.CCY, T.IS_INTERBANK, T.IS_LOOP_AMT, T.HOLD_MATURITY, T.CREDIT_OBJ, T.APPR_VDATE, T.APPR_MDATE, T.CREDIT_VDATE, T.CREDIT_MDATE, T.CREATE_USER, T.CREATE_DEPT, T.CREATE_TIME, T.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME FROM CREDIT_LINES T LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL T1 ON T.CUSTOMER_ID=T1.SEQNO LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T2 ON T2.SEQNO=T1.SEQNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.SEQNO, SUM(M.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, SUM(M.NEW_AMOUNT) NEW_AMOUNT FROM CREDIT_USING_SERIES M INNER JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL D ON D.FINPROD_ID = M.FINPROD_ID WHERE M.CDATE <= #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND M.STATUS = '01' GROUP BY D.SEQNO ) TM ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = TM.SEQNO WHERE T.CREDIT_MST_ID=#{creditmstidXL,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (T2.FINPROD_ID=SUBSTR(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, INSTR(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '_')+1) OR T2.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR T2.FINPROD_ID = (SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND T.VDATE = (SELECT MAX(CL.VDATE) FROM CREDIT_LINES CL WHERE T.CREDIT_MST_ID = CL.CREDIT_MST_ID and T.CUSTOMER_ID = CL.CUSTOMER_ID AND CL.VDATE <= #{tradeDate} AND CL.MDATE >= #{tradeDate} ) AND T.VDATE <= #{tradeDate} AND T.MDATE >= #{tradeDate}
